patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within full-bleed, dark-themed sections, often separated by significant vertical black space to emphasize individual content blocks.
A strong typographic contrast is used, pairing large, elegant serif headings with smaller, functional sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for navigation and interactive elements.
The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with a dominant black background, white text, and subtle light blue/cyan glows or accents, creating a futuristic and sophisticated feel.
Major content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they scroll into view, while the hero video background exhibits a gentle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content.
Interactive cards with dropdowns are used in key sections (hero, 'Explore the AWE') to present complex information or options in a clean, contained manner.

technique_notes: Implement scroll-triggered animations using a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger to detect when sections enter the viewport. Apply a combination of opacity and Y-axis transform animations to make elements fade in and slide up from the bottom, creating a staggered reveal effect for content within each section. The hero background video should have a slower scroll speed than the foreground content, achieving a subtle parallax effect. The main navigation should be fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining its appearance without transformation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) with generous letter spacing, contrasted with smaller, functional sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like cards, buttons, and input fields, maintaining a clean yet approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections, creating a sense of grandeur and allowing each content block to breathe and command attention.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark aesthetic combined with elegant serif typography and subtle, futuristic glowing grid patterns creates a highly sophisticated and immersive experience. The interactive hero card with its dropdowns also stands out, offering a unique way to engage users immediately with complex options within a minimalist design.
